leadText:
Pokémon 4-Koma Comic Strip (Japanese: ポケモン４コマ Pokémon 4Koma Plaza) is a Pokémon 4Koma by Takahiro Yamashita. It is published once weekly each Monday on Pokémon Daisuki Club in .

Starting in September 2020, English versions of each comic began to be posted on the official Pokémon social media accounts in (Facebook, Instagram), (Facebook), (Facebook), and (Facebook, Instagram). The social media accounts in (Bilibili, Weibo), (Facebook), (Facebook, Instagram), (Facebook, Instagram), (Facebook, Instagram), and (Facebook) also post versions of the comic in the respective local languages.
